options.label: Map owners and handoffs
options.prompt: Using only the recorded deliveries list, produce a read-only ownership and handoff map: group each delivery by its existing owner (worker IDs vs. Codex release operator/root release coordination), note its recorded status and blocking reason verbatim, and state which blocked items are waiting on operator-confirmed scope, target and acceptance. Do not propose new actions, owners, acceptance or settings changes, and make clear that unrecorded status is UNKNOWN rather than inferred.

options.label: Trace superseded/replacement pair
options.prompt: Read-only check of the handoff between auto-b69f469019a353ca5e0cd0747f3cbcbf (superseded restricted attempt, blocked, to be preserved) and its stated replacement auto-5ee3dda6e61420b3b927164ed5f4b98a (Codex root release coordination, no_action). Summarize what the records say about which attempt is authoritative and what is recorded as still missing. Do not propose acceptance, new work or a different owner; flag anything unrecorded as UNKNOWN.

options.label: Trace repair-46 chain handoffs
